provenance: Original templates authored in this repository; no external data collected.
review_method: Local code and template inspection during sprint 2; not independent human adjudication of every generated row.

documentation-placeholder.rationale: Explicit your_key_here markers represent instructions to supply a value.
documentation-placeholder.limitations: A placeholder-looking literal can still be deployed as a password.

environment-reference.rationale: Environment expressions name variables and contain no resolved secret value.
environment-reference.limitations: Environment values are unknown; this label applies only to the expression.

uuid.rationale: Invented UUIDs are assigned to request identifiers.
uuid.limitations: UUIDs used as bearer credentials would require a different label.

content-hash.rationale: SHA-256 digests are computed from invented content and labeled as content hashes.
content-hash.limitations: Hexadecimal shape alone cannot distinguish a hash from a secret.

build-id.rationale: Invented build identifiers describe build metadata.
build-id.limitations: Real build metadata may contain accidentally embedded secrets.

documentation-url.rationale: Invented documentation URLs use .invalid and contain no authentication material.
documentation-url.limitations: Real URLs can carry credentials in user information, paths, or queries.

test-dummy.rationale: Explicit dummy_for_test markers are invented locally and assigned only in synthetic examples.
test-dummy.limitations: The presence of test or dummy is insufficient evidence for real repository values.

version.rationale: Three numeric components describe an invented package version.
version.limitations: Unusual version metadata may require contextual review.

css-color.rationale: Three six-digit hexadecimal colors form an invented theme palette.
css-color.limitations: This is an easy negative and does not represent credential-shaped hard negatives.

numeric-id.rationale: Invented numeric issue identifiers are non-authenticating metadata.
numeric-id.limitations: Numeric PINs or access codes in other contexts can be secrets.
